name: Rutland Recreation Summer Day Camps
description_short: Summer day camps run by the Rutland Recreation and Parks Department: Preschool Camp, Camp Maple Leaf and Camp Green Mountain. In 2026 they ran 8 weeks, Monday to Friday, June 22 to August 14, and were full.

warnings: This is an overview page that lists many separate programs (summer day camps, theatre, sports, art, skateboard, break camps, babysitter training). It is not one camp's page, and none of the programs list dates, prices or sessions.
The page does not show a season year, so season_year is left blank.
Several programs on this page (babysitter training, February and April break camps) are not summer camps.
The only registration link found is attached to the February Break Camp 'READ MORE' entry (vermontsystems.com). It was not used as the registration link for the summer camps.
unknowns: Season year and session dates for each camp
Age or grade ranges for the summer day camps (only the break camps say grades K-6)
Hours and whether before or after care is offered
Details of the refund policy (the page only links to 'Refund Policies and Requests')
Who qualifies for the scholarship program
Whether there is swimming or waterfront activity

changes: Refocused the listing on the Summer Day Camps: name now 'Rutland Recreation Summer Day Camps' and website_url the Summer Day Camps 2026 page. The old draft described the whole camps-and-classes menu (theatre, skateboard, babysitter training, February and April break camps), which are separate programs and mostly not summer camps.
Set season_year 2026 from that page: 8 weeks, Monday to Friday, June 22 to August 14, 2026, marked FULL.
Removed the activities list and the sports/arts/performing_arts categories: they belonged to the other programs, and the day camp page does not describe its program, so categories are left empty.
Added registration_url (the department's Rec1 catalog linked as 'Register here') and the 2026 summer camp refund policy.
No sessions added: the page gives only the season span, not whether weeks are sold separately. No ages, grades or prices are published; the Rec1 catalog shows nothing without JavaScript.
open_questions: The Summer Day Camps page names three camps (Preschool Camp, Camp Maple Leaf, Camp Green Mountain) but gives no ages, prices or weekly sessions for any of them. List them as one thin listing, split into three, or wait for the 2027 page?
Theatre, sports, art and skateboard summer camps on the overview page are left out. Draft them separately?

refund_policy_summary: For 2026 summer camp: 90% refund if you withdraw on or before June 15, 2026; no refunds from June 16.
